clean.tx: iwa ala inim andaawe umbenam unda ndï we ndïin u kundan nïmban ndïwalie ndïkuk nji awe
clean.tl: would put fish traps in the water, go to them in the morning, and then, from within them, kill eels and fish and gather them into something .

clean.tx: ndïkuk nji awe mï wolka i ndïn up
clean.tl: After gathering them into something, she again went and set them.
Having gone, again went and gathered them .

clean.tx: ndïi we ie way nungol kotïn
clean.tl: went to them, and having gone, caught a little turtle.
The little turtle was in the trap.
